notes:
User enjoys experimenting with specialty coffee, citrus flavors, tea blends, and food pairings. They primarily use a French press and recently adjusted their preferred ratio to 1 tablespoon (roughly 10–12 g) of coffee per 5 oz/148 mL water. They are excited to brew recently received new beans in the morning, particularly bright, citrus-forward varieties such as Kenyan coffee. They previously signed up for an unspecified coffee subscription and received their first shipment yesterday.

User enjoys herbal and specialty teas. They are considering relaxing chamomile alternatives such as lavender, tulsi, rooibos, passionflower, or valerian. They are considering trying a tea subscription and has narrowed its choices to Adagio Teas and The Tea Spot; prior assistant-suggested discount codes and offers may be outdated, so verify current promotions before citing them. They plan to organize their tea cabinet and asked how to keep tea fresh: use airtight, opaque containers; store cool, dry, away from sunlight, moisture, odors, and heat; consider small batches; and inspect periodically for staleness, mold, or pests.

User received a new rose tea from their sister and wondered whether it pairs with shortbread; the suggested pairing is good. Other possibilities include strawberries, vanilla or lemon cake, and white or rose-infused chocolate truffles.

User asked how to clean a French press thoroughly, especially old coffee oils. General guidance: disassemble, wash promptly with hot soapy water, scrub gently, rinse well, and dry completely. For stubborn residue, use a soft brush and optionally a baking-soa or diluted-vinegar solution; avoid abrasives and usually avoid the dishwasher. Do not recommend dilute bleach routinely unless the manufacturer permits it.

Coffee storage guidance: keep whole beans airtight in a cool, dark room-temperature location, away from moisture, heat, and odors; grind just before brewing; use opened beans within roughly two weeks; refrigerate or freeze only airtight and, for longer storage, portion before freezing. No location, budget, specific tea subscription choice, roast preference, or coffee subscription provider has been stated.
